topics: Tribals: Concept, Meaning and Definition
Origin and Classification of Tribals: Geographical, Linguistic, Racial and Cultural

importantNotes: Negative marking: 25% or 1/4th of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
If more than one answer is given for a question, it will be treated as wrong and 25% or 1/4th of the marks will be deducted.
If the sum of final marks results in a fraction, it will remain as a fraction and further processing will be done based on that.
If a question is left unattempted by a candidate, negative marking will not apply.
Final merit list will be based on combined marks of objective examination and interview.
